Test WRITING SUB-TEST:        MEDICINE
TIME ALLOWED:                 READING TIME: 5 MINUTES
                              WRITING TIME: 40 MINUTES



Read the case notes and complete the writing task which follows



Notes
Mr Michael Reed is a patient at your GP clinic, Bayview Medical Centre.



Patient Details

Name​:                Mr Michael Reed

D.O.B:                24/10/1979 (39 years old)

Address:              52 A Wilson Court, Wilson Crescent, Bayview

Occupation​:          Warehouse operative
                      Picks orders in a large warehouse (includes forklift truck driving,
                      periods of prolonged standing and sitting, occasional lifting). Works
                      shifts.



Social background: Married - Shamina Reed, 1 child (wife pregnant)

Hobbies​:             Rugby, fishing, DIY

Medical history​:     1989 - Appendix removed
                      1991 - Fracture to wrist (L)
                      Allergic to penicillin



Current medication

               Diclofenac (non-steroidal and anti-inflammatory drug)
               Carisoprodol (muscle relaxant, blocks pain)

03/6/19        Hurt back gardening.
               Took painkillers, went to work, no rest, pain worsening.
               Presented 2 days post initial strain.
 
X-ray:         No disc problems
               Diagnosis:     Lower back strain - severe.
               Treatment:     Exercise: gentle walking daily - ↟ time / distance
                              Referral to physiotherapist
                              Prescribed: Diclofenac, carisoprodol
                              15 days off work - certificate provided for employer
                              Will review in 2 weeks.

17/06/19       Pt moving stiffly; exercises very painful, but compliant.
               Walking 10 mins a day.
               Further 15 days rest prescribed.



27/06/19       Progressing slowly - ↟ROM - still in pain.
               Pain after 20 mins sitting / lying down.
               Very tired after exercise. Pt. worried - not used to being inactive.
               Further 15 days rest prescribed.

10/07/19       Walking 20 - 25 mins a day.
               2 more physio sessions left.
               Pt. still in pain.
               Prescribed ↟Diclofenac. Pt reluctant - afraid of addiction.
               Pt. bored, anxious about baby’s arrival.
               Doesn’t want to lose job. Keen to return to workplace. Employer supportive.

               Fit to work certificate issued: return to work possible with amended duties - no
               lifting + regular breaks.
               Letter to OT requesting assessment of w/p (advise on duties can perform
               etc.)

Writing Task

Using the information in the case notes, write a letter to Mr Asad Iqbal, an Occupational
Therapist detailing Mr Reed’s situation and requesting an assessment of his workplace.
Address the letter to Mr Asad Iqbal, Golders Park Occupational Health Centre, Bayview.
